name: update_only_versioned
comment: The column-list UPDATE (ADR-0028) as the hooks shape it: the listed property plus the [UpdatedAt] stamp the session appends (spec/hooks.md), the version rules of the full-row form.

expect.sqlite: update transactions set amount = @amount, updated_at = @updated_at, version = version + 1 where id = @id and version = @version
expect.sqlserver: set nocount on; update [transactions] set [amount] = @amount, [updated_at] = @updated_at, [version] = [version] + 1 where [id] = @id and [version] = @version; select @@rowcount; set nocount off
